name: parvez-tools
description: Parvez's personal Claude Code toolkit — skills, hooks, and commands for building and shipping projects.

plugins.name: parvez
plugins.description: All-in-one toolkit. Ship: vps-deploy (push-to-deploy CI/CD + OAuth + DNS/TLS + hardening), honest-health-check (real readiness probes), clean-architecture (rulebook + bootstrap + layering guard). Refactor: refactoring-guru orchestrator + code-smell-detector, refactoring-methods, and creational/structural/behavioral pattern scorers. Review: platform-audit (DRY across a backlog), grill-feature (promise-level code interrogation). Plus show-usage (local time/token/cost stats).
